# ClickHouse Server (`clickhouse-clickhouse`)

Unlock real-time data insights effortlessly with ClickHouse, the lightning-fast, open-source columnar database. Elevate your analytics and make data-driven decisions with speed and precision like never before!

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-ClickHouse.html) · [Source](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "clickhouse-clickhouse"
  name       = "myclickhouse"

  parameters = {
    # Db   = "..."
    # User = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    Password = var.password
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Db` | string | no | Name of a database to create at first start if it does not exist (upstream env CLICKHOUSE_DB). Optional; example: analytics. |
| `User` | string | no | Username of the ClickHouse user to create at first start (upstream env CLICKHOUSE_USER, default 'default'). Use together with Password; example: admin. |
| `Password` | string | no | Password for the ClickHouse user named in User (upstream env CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD). Choose a strong value; if neither user nor password is set upstream disables network access for the default user. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
